cues.zhText: 归根结底，阑尾炎的本质主要是炎症，离不开变质和渗出两个过程。
cues.enText: Fundamentally, appendicitis is inflammation driven by two core processes: tissue alteration and exudation.

cues.zhText: 它遵循经典的“梗阻—感染”机制：管腔以粪石为主堵塞后，腔内压升高、缺血并继发细菌感染，致黏膜变性坏死脱落，即“变质”。
cues.enText: It follows the classic obstruction-infection model: luminal blockage, mainly by a fecalith, raises pressure, causes ischemia and bacterial invasion, leading to mucosal necrosis—alteration.

cues.zhText: 黏膜破损后，组胺、缓激肽、前列腺素与趋化因子等炎症介质释放，引起血管充血、通透性升高，血浆被挤出或漏出；中性粒细胞则非被动挤出，而是在介质引导下经边集、滚动、黏附，以阿米巴样运动主动游出血管壁。
cues.enText: Once mucosa breaks, mediators—histamine, bradykinin, prostaglandins, chemokines—drive congestion and permeability so plasma leaks out, while neutrophils actively emigrate via margination, rolling, adhesion, and amoeboid diapedesis.

cues.zhText: 炎症为何迅速向肌层与浆膜层蔓延？那是因为感染的链球菌产生链激酶，激活纤溶酶原、促进纤维素降解，并配合透明质酸酶分解间质，溶解原本局限病灶的纤维素性渗出，使炎症蔓延至各层，故又称急性蜂窝织性阑尾炎。
cues.enText: Why does inflammation spread rapidly across the wall? Streptococcal streptokinase activates plasminogen to degrade fibrin while hyaluronidase breaks down matrix, dissolving confining exudate so suppuration spreads diffusely—hence acute phlegmonous appendicitis.

cues.zhText: 在浆膜面，渗出并变性坏死的中性粒细胞形成大量脓细胞，混有交织纤维素构成纤维素性脓性渗出物，覆盖表面，肉眼即为灰黄色脓苔。
cues.enText: On the serosal surface, degenerated neutrophils form pus cells interwoven with fibrin into a fibrinous-purulent exudate, appearing grossly as a gray-yellow purulent coat.
